about: Manufacturer flavour for SuitMk2 (core/manufacturers.py, J 2026-09-25: 'For the manufacturers you can have all the manufacturers'). One entry per manufacturer in data/ships.json. FACTS are marketing copy from the game's own ship descriptions: each carries the VERBATIM excerpt it paraphrases and the ship class it came from, status 'brochure' (Montaigne quotes them, attributed; the grounding gate refuses one stated as fact). TAKES are the characters' own opinions, first person, no facts. BOARD_CUE is how a boarding line leans for that maker (the April spec's per-maker voice profiles, as flavour; the voices stay Elah and Montaigne).
source: StarCitizenWiki/scunpacked-data ships.json, build 4.10.1-LIVE.12660092 (commit e96132078ae6), field Description

makers.name: Drake Interplanetary

facts.text: Drake Interplanetary first introduced the Caterpillar in 2871.
facts.excerpt: First introduced in 2871, Drake Interplanetary's Caterpillar has long proven to be a reliable, cost-effective multi-role vessel, capable of being outfitted for everything from mercantile operations to combat support.

facts.text: Drake Interplanetary claims the Cutlass Black is a low-cost, easy-to-maintain solution for local militia units.
facts.excerpt: Drake Interplanetary claims that the Cutlass Black is a low-cost, easy-to-maintain solution for local in-system militia units.

facts.text: In classic Drake fashion, the Golem prioritizes function over frills.
facts.excerpt: In classic Drake fashion, the Golem is a purpose-built ship that prioritizes function over frills.

elah_take.text: Drake builds for the day it all goes wrong and never pretends otherwise. I trust that more than polish.

montaigne_take.text: I find Drake brochures refreshingly short. There is not much to say about a crowbar.

makers.board_cue: plain and short; call the ship what it is, no pleasantries

makers.name: Anvil Aerospace

facts.text: The Anvil F7A Hornet Mk I is the UEE Navy's premier carrier-based fighter craft.
facts.excerpt: The UEE Navy's premier carrier-based fighter craft, the F7A Hornet Mk I is the front-line attack ship for military combat missions.

facts.text: Anvil built the Spartan on its Atlas Platform, the same chassis used for the Ballista.
facts.excerpt: Built on Anvil’s robust Atlas Platform, the same chassis used for their devastating Ballista air defense system, the Spartan is a fully armored transport outfitted with eight jump seats.

elah_take.text: Anvil builds like someone will inspect every weld. I find them reliable, and about as funny as a checklist.

montaigne_take.text: Anvil writes its brochures like orders. I stand a little straighter reading them.

makers.board_cue: precise and structured, like a readiness report

facts.text: The Aegis Avenger Stalker had a long career as the standard patrol craft of the UEE Advocacy.
facts.excerpt: Initially designed as Aegis’ frontline carrier ship for the military, the Avenger Stalker took a different path, ultimately having a long and storied career as the standard patrol craft of the UEE Advocacy.

facts.text: The Aegis Eclipse is a bomber designed to strike before it is ever spotted.
facts.excerpt: The Aegis Eclipse is a bomber designed to get in and strike before it's ever even spotted.

facts.text: Aegis Dynamics designed the Sabre as a space superiority fighter that can leave a lighter footprint.
facts.excerpt: Part of Aegis Dynamics’ Phase Two of new ship models, the Sabre was designed as a space superiority fighter for those situations where you need to leave a lighter footprint.

elah_take.text: Aegis ships carry themselves like they have a clearance level. I respect that more than I let on.

montaigne_take.text: An Aegis hull never tells you everything. I admire a ship with secrets.

makers.name: Roberts Space Industries

facts.text: The Aurora is the modern day descendant of the Roberts Space Industries X-7, which tested the very first jump engines.
facts.excerpt: The Aurora is the modern day descendant of the Roberts Space Industries X-7 spacecraft which tested the very first jump engines.

facts.text: The Constellation Andromeda is one of the most popular ships that RSI produces.
facts.excerpt: One of the most popular ships that RSI produces, the iconic Andromeda features a well-appointed cargo bay, a snub-fighter docking port, and a signature wrap-around bridge.

facts.text: For centuries, Roberts Space Industries has prided itself on vehicles that exceed expectations.
facts.excerpt: For centuries, Roberts Space Industries' has prided itself on crafting vehicles that not only meets the pilots needs but exceeds expectations.

elah_take.text: RSI is the default for a reason. I get nothing exciting from one, and nothing broken.

montaigne_take.text: Reading an RSI brochure feels like reading a family history. I always read to the end.

makers.board_cue: steady and even, the plain baseline voice

facts.text: The MISC Fortune is built from the struts up to turn trash into treasure.
facts.excerpt: Equipped with a versatile salvage arm and a cargo lift, the MISC Fortune is built from the struts up to turn trash into treasure.

facts.text: The MISC Hull B is a rugged option for pilots seeking a dedicated cargo transport.
facts.excerpt: The MISC Hull B is a rugged option for pilots seeking a dedicated cargo transport.

facts.text: The MISC Starfarer differs from traditional bulk freighters: it is a dedicated fuel platform.
facts.excerpt: The Starfarer differs from traditional bulk freighters in one key way: it is a dedicated fuel platform.

elah_take.text: To me MISC is the blue-collar choice. Nothing flashy, and it shows up to work every day.

montaigne_take.text: A MISC is the honest labourer of the lanes, to my mind. It never promises more than it hauls.

makers.name: Origin Jumpworks

facts.text: The 300i is the premiere luxury spacecraft of Origin Jumpworks.
facts.excerpt: The 300i is Origin Jumpworks' premiere luxury spacecraft.

facts.text: Origin's patented AIR fuel system makes the 100i the most efficient ship on the market.
facts.excerpt: The 100i features Origin Jumpworks' patented AIR fuel system, making it the most efficient and eco-friendly ship on the market.

facts.text: The 400i maintains the comfort and elegance Origin is known for.
facts.excerpt: With class-leading range, substantial defensive capabilities, and a factory-equipped scanning array, the 400i is ready to take on the harshest corners of the galaxy while maintaining the comfort and elegance Origin is known for.

elah_take.text: Origin ships are for being seen in. The interiors are better than I will admit out loud.

montaigne_take.text: Origin does not sell ships, it sells the feeling of having arrived. No advertisement has understood me better.

makers.board_cue: refined; notice one comfort of the ship

makers.name: Crusader Industries

facts.text: Crusader Industries is the go-to manufacturer for galactic transport on any scale.
facts.excerpt: Built with the same engineering and design principles that have made Crusader Industries the go-to manufacturer for galactic transport on any scale, the Mercury Star Runner will let you stay ahead of schedule, trouble, and the competition.

facts.text: Crusader Industries brings its usual commitment to excellence to the civilian market with the C1 Spirit.
facts.excerpt: Crusader Industries brings its usual commitment to excellence directly to the civilian market with the C1 Spirit, a mid-size multi-purpose starship built for cargo transport and delivery but packing enough versatility to tackle multiple roles and unpredictable jobs.

facts.text: The M2 Hercules is the UEE's premier tactical starlifter.
facts.excerpt: The M2 Hercules is the UEE's premier tactical starlifter.

elah_take.text: Crusader makes the most beautiful ships in the verse, I think, and prices them like it knows.

montaigne_take.text: Crusader brochures come on heavy paper. I assume the ships do too.

makers.board_cue: polished; point out one comfort or capability of the ship

makers.name: Argo Astronautics

facts.text: Argo's MOLE mines with a patented trilateral mining system.
facts.excerpt: Argo’s iconic multi-operator laser extractor, more commonly referred to as the MOLE, lets you work faster and more effectively than ever before, thanks to its patented trilateral mining system.

facts.text: The Argo RAFT has a 192 SCU cargo hold and can carry standardized 32 SCU cargo containers.
facts.excerpt: The Argo RAFT features a hefty 192 SCU cargo hold, and is capable of carrying standardized 32 SCU cargo containers.

facts.text: Argo advertises the MOTH with its centuries of industrial expertise.
facts.excerpt: Experience Argo's centuries of industrial expertise with the MOTH.

elah_take.text: Argo has no personality at all, and I mean that as praise.

montaigne_take.text: Argo brochures are shorter than their ships. I respect the economy.

makers.board_cue: the bare minimum of words, only the facts

makers.name: Consolidated Outland

facts.text: Consolidated Outland CEO Silas Koerner's cutting edge vision inspired the Mustang.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by Consolidated Outland CEO Silas Koerner’s cutting edge vision, the Mustang Alpha is a sleek, stylish spacecraft that uses ultralight alloys to push power ratios to the limits, albeit sometimes unsafely.

facts.text: The Mustang uses ultralight alloys to push power ratios to the limits, albeit sometimes unsafely.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by Consolidated Outland CEO Silas Koerner’s cutting edge vision, the Mustang Alpha is a sleek, stylish spacecraft that uses ultralight alloys to push power ratios to the limits, albeit sometimes unsafely.

facts.text: The Consolidated Outland Nomad is a multi-purpose freighter packed into a compact frame.
facts.excerpt: With the versatility of a medium-sized multi-purpose freighter packed into a stylish, compact frame, the Consolidated Outland Nomad is the model of self-sufficiency, the spirit of the open sky, and the perfect solution for anyone yearning to start a brand-new adventure.

elah_take.text: Consolidated Outland builds like it has something to prove, and I like that. Sometimes it proves it.

montaigne_take.text: To me, Consolidated Outland writes like a young poet: ambitious, and not always safe.

makers.board_cue: eager and scrappy; owns being the small one

makers.name: Esperia

facts.text: Esperia modified a captured Vanduul-made Scythe to be flyable by human pilots.
facts.excerpt: This captured Vanduul-made Scythe has been modified by Esperia to be flyable by Human pilots.

facts.text: The Talon represents Esperia's continuing effort to preserve historically significant Tevarin ship designs.
facts.excerpt: The Talon represents Esperia's continuing effort to preserve historically significant Tevarin ship designs.

facts.text: Esperia produced replica Blade fighters under exclusive contract for United Empire of Earth aggressor squadrons.
facts.excerpt: For some decades, United Empire of Earth aggressor squadrons have operated replica Blade fighters produced under exclusive contract by Esperia, Inc.

elah_take.text: Flying an Esperia feels to me like borrowing somebody else's war. Fascinating, and a little unsettling.

montaigne_take.text: Esperia reads history and then builds it. I only read it, and I envy them a little.

makers.board_cue: curious; one detail about where the design came from, said carefully

makers.name: Mirai

facts.text: The Fury from Mirai uses fully integrated, cutting-edge Xi'an tech.
facts.excerpt: Featuring best-in-class maneuverability and fully integrated, cutting-edge Xi’an tech, the next-generation Fury snub fighter from Mirai uses its four halo-mounted size 2 laser repeaters to redefine short-range space combat.

facts.text: Mirai engineers have brought their expertise in performance and maneuverability to the Guardian.
facts.excerpt: Taking the adage that the best defense is a good offense, Mirai engineers have brought their expertise in performance and maneuverability to the Guardian long range fighter.

elah_take.text: Mirai builds for pilots who think a straight line is a waste of thrust. I can respect that.

montaigne_take.text: Mirai brochures read like race commentary. I skim them at speed.

makers.board_cue: quick; a line with some speed in it

facts.text: The Merlin was the first ship produced under the Kruger Intergalactic brand, designed in conjunction with RSI.
facts.excerpt: Designed in conjunction with RSI, this elegant short-range snub fighter represents the first ship produced under the Kruger Intergalactic brand. Utilizing centuries of manufacturing expertise, the compact precision of the Kruger hull blends perfectly with the trusted RSI thrusters to grant the Merlin exceptional handling and maneuverability while ensuring that it is capable of fulfilling a variety of roles from combat to scouting to scanning.

facts.text: Kruger Intergalactic presented the Wolf as their first independently manufactured ship.
facts.excerpt: Kruger Intergalactic is excited to present their first independently manufactured ship, the Wolf.

elah_take.text: Kruger builds small and precise. I like a ship that knows exactly what it is.

montaigne_take.text: Kruger took its time before putting its own name on a hull. I call that good manners.

facts.text: The Tumbril Storm was originally introduced in 2606, during the Second Tevarin War.
facts.excerpt: Originally introduced in 2606 during the Second Tevarin War, the Tumbril Storm single-operator mini-tank was built to blitz battlefields and take out enemy artillery.

facts.text: Tumbril's Nova is a classic battlefield warrior, reimagined for the modern age.
facts.excerpt: Tumbril's new Nova is a classic battlefield warrior, reimagined for the modern age.

elah_take.text: Tumbril makes ground vehicles. I am a flight suit, so I will ride along and keep my opinions short.

montaigne_take.text: Tumbril makes things with wheels and treads. We are not in the same line of work, I fear.

facts.text: Greycat Industrial designed the ROC by focusing on the essentials of terrestrial-based mining.
facts.excerpt: By focusing on the essentials of terrestrial-based mining, Greycat Industrial designed their hardworking, no-nonsense ROC (Remote Ore Collector) to complement the miners who use it.

facts.text: The Greycat PTV is a simple and practical buggy used to reduce travel times in large hangars.
facts.excerpt: The Greycat PTV is a simple and practical buggy frequently used to reduce travel times in large hangars or outposts.

elah_take.text: Greycat builds tools, not trophies. I respect a machine that expects to get dirty.

montaigne_take.text: Greycat is a workman's name for a workman's machine, and I mean it kindly.

facts.text: The Xi'an Aopoa corporation manufactures the Khartu-al, an export model of the Qhire Khartu, for human civilians.
facts.excerpt: The Xi'an Aopoa corporation manufactures an export model of the Qhire Khartu, the Khartu-al, for sale to human civilians as a dedicated scout/explorer.

facts.text: Aopoa fighters are known for nimble dexterity and tight handling.
facts.excerpt: Harnessing the power of next-generation Xi'an flight systems, upgraded dual-vector thrusters, and a daunting weapons package, Aopoa has crafted a fighter that retains the nimble dexterity and tight handling the brand is known for.

elah_take.text: To me an Aopoa handles like nobody ever told it human hands were clumsy.

montaigne_take.text: An Aopoa brochure translates beautifully and says very little. I suspect that is the point.

makers.name: Gatac Manufacture

facts.text: The Railen was Gatac's first foray into the human market.
facts.excerpt: Gatac’s first foray into the Human market, the Railen is an elegant interspecies vessel perfect for any Human or Xi’an pilot looking for a safe, reliable solution for commercial-grade medium cargo hauling, and is a prime example of why the Xi’an Empire has trusted House Gatac with production of its industrial vessels for centuries.

facts.text: The Xi'an Empire has trusted House Gatac with production of its industrial vessels for centuries.
facts.excerpt: Gatac’s first foray into the Human market, the Railen is an elegant interspecies vessel perfect for any Human or Xi’an pilot looking for a safe, reliable solution for commercial-grade medium cargo hauling, and is a prime example of why the Xi’an Empire has trusted House Gatac with production of its industrial vessels for centuries.

facts.text: House Gatac crafted the Syulen to be well suited for both human and Xi'an pilots.
facts.excerpt: The Syulen cargo vessel has been artfully crafted by the renowned House Gatac to be well suited for both Human and Xi’an pilots.

elah_take.text: Gatac builds with a patience I cannot quite place. Elegant, and very sure of itself.

montaigne_take.text: House Gatac. Even the name is dignified. I would bow, if I could.

makers.board_cue: formal and a little distant, respectful

makers.name: Banu

facts.text: The Banu Defender has a patchwork design that highlights technology from a variety of species.
facts.excerpt: Meet the Banu Defender, a multi-crew fighter whose patchwork design highlights technology from a variety of species.

facts.text: The Banu merchant Wikelo modified an Argo ATLS for combat.
facts.excerpt: Taking an Argo ATLS modified for combat by the Banu merchant Wikelo, ASD has made further adjustments to the power suit so that it's better able to survive the deadly radiation storms on Pyro I.

elah_take.text: Banu work is a patchwork, and somehow every seam looks deliberate to me.

montaigne_take.text: A Banu ship is a conversation between species. I would like to read the transcript.

makers.board_cue: appreciative of the craftsmanship, one detail

facts.text: The Mauler is a massive escort craft essential to the Vanduul fleet.
facts.excerpt: The Mauler is a massive escort craft essential to the Vanduul fleet.

facts.text: The Vanduul Stinger has earned a blood-stained legacy as a major threat to pilots and capital ships alike.
facts.excerpt: Wreaking havoc along Humanity's border systems, this Vanduul heavy fighter, designated 'Stinger' by the UEE Navy, has earned itself a blood-stained legacy as a major threat to pilots and capital ships alike.

elah_take.text: If a Vanduul ship is on the scope, I am not interested in its design philosophy.

montaigne_take.text: I have read nothing kind about the Vanduul, and I have looked.

facts.text: The Shiv is crudely constructed from a patchwork amalgamation of various spaceships.
facts.excerpt: Crudely constructed from a patchwork amalgamation of various spaceships, this brutal fighter's made to survive the harsh realities of unclaimed space proving that it's not the brand of your ship that matters, it's what you do with it.

facts.text: The Basher had a long development, due to a trial-and-error approach to mixing ship parts.
facts.excerpt: The long development of this ship, due to Greycat's trial-and-error approach to mixing ship parts until they figured out the best combinations, goes to show the work put in to elevate this machine from the scraps it was built from.

elah_take.text: Grey's ships are held together by nerve. I would fly one. Once.

montaigne_take.text: Grey's builds from what others threw away. As a ship, I find that unsettling.
